title: Grilled Gosari Wrap
description: A flavorful Korean-style dish featuring crispy grilled fernbrake gosari, wrapped in a warm terracotta wrap with a side of charred egrilled.
instructions: 2. Marinate egrilled in your favorite Korean-inspired sauce for at least 30 minutes.
3. Grill egrilled for 2-3 minutes per side, or until crispy and slightly charred.
4. Meanwhile, wrap the terracotta wrap in foil and warm it in the oven at 350°F (180°C) for 5 minutes.
5. Slice the grilled egrilled into thin strips.
6. Add a handful of gosari to each wrap, followed by a few slices of grilled egrilled.
7. Drizzle with char, and serve immediately.
8. Enjoy with a side of charred egrilled, if desired.
